nom: ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder

avis.texte: Texture person here: This is lile "washing" with slime. Its far harder to get off than even natural aloe. It is impossible to get out of my hairline. I dont feel like it cleans anything but it does make skin soft!! I am not into korean skincare product textures at all! Just goopy slime weird no.
It made my skin break out the first few times but then it cleared up and made my skin glow

i like the face wash it leaves my skin feeling hydrated, but the packaging is so bad. Its not water tight which is a big issue since it's powder. i had it in my shower and started noticing not much was coming out so i took the top off and saw that alot of the powder had hardened i think because moisture got in. it makes me worry that if moisture can get inside the bottle then bacteria could grow inside.
First time trying this face cleanser and I love it so far! My face is so soft and clear!
It turns sort of slimy when it starts to mix with the water and It didnt really work for my sensitive skin.
This rice powder does wonders. I have dry/dull skin and this not only cleans my skin but alao leaves a nice glow that lasts the entire day.
I cannot say enough about the effectiveness of this cleansing powder - my skin feels brand new every time I use it!

I love anua so much! I swear down on it. I was interested in this product to help brighten acne scars. I used it once and felt fine at first. I used in the morning and then at night time my face started getting a bit itchy. When I woke up the next morning I had a rash on my face. I guess I am allergic to one of the ingredients. I read other reviews and saw that they had the same reaction but I still wanted to try it.
i have only been using this for a couple of days but my skin already feels much softer and smoother. it is very gentle and does not irrtate my skin. i will most likely be purchasing this again.
I love this product so much cleared, brightened, and exfoliated my skin
You see the results instantly, I use it on my sensitive skin and I love how it feels. Definitely a good use before waxing on all areas as well!

I wanted to try this after reading the benefits and I really love how my skin feels after using it. Just a little bit of powder is all you need for a nice exfoliating lather. I've become an Anua fan. I also use the rice milk toner and cleansing oil.

I have sensitive, dry, roseacea skin and this is my new holy grail for exfoliating a few times a week! I love the sticky texture and its fun to play with in the shower before use. It makes my skin soft and smooth.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I've been using this product for a little over a week. I've only used it twice. I think it's great. It's kind of frothy when mixed with water, and it comes out of the container in the perfect amount, which I think is great no guess work needed. I need to purchase the toner to try with this. Great price too. Skin is soft and smooth. Overall clarity is bright. Pores look smaller and smoother. Highly recommend, ladies. Lee A
This creates a kind of film over your skin and makes it hard to wash off. I had to use another cleanser to get it off of my face.
Product foams nicely. Non-drying and polishes for glass skin. Use less than you think.

avis.titre: I would buy this productos again
avis.texte: I've been using this rice exfoliating I could feel how soft and smooth my skin became. It has a gentle texture, .It's now a must-have in my skincare routine!

Seriously one of the best products i have EVER used. It brightened my skin after a couple uses and my skin feels absolutely silky smooth afterwards. I never write reviews but I completely stand by this product and would recommend it to anyone especially with dry skin.
I have tried other rice powder cleaners and wanted to try this one. I did not like that it was very course and did not lather too much. It was also very slimy and hard to rinse off. It's a no for me.

I have an uneven skin texture just from having dry skin (esthetician told me this) I was told this would be a good exfoliating product due to it exfoliating under the skin as well as on top. When I tell you i used this product and then as soon as i washed it off I immediately saw a hige difference. My face looked brighter. There was a very slight burn from it feeling dryer. But overall good product!

This as being my go to every night now and it's working.. it's additional to my Anua and am loving it. And I will say whatever reviews people gives you can still give it a try in my opinion cos whatever that not works for others might work well for you. Our body reacts to things differently

When I tell you everything breaks me out into a hive-y, fungal acne mess, I mean it with my whole heart. This stuff has been incredible. No reactions and my skin is definitely in a better state than before I used it. Also very fun to use! Face is soft, smooth and even calmer. Really love it and will repurchase back ups upon back ups. I don't want to be without it.
First time trying but would repurchase! I have pretty sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my skin. It did cause some peeling a few days later but leaves my skin soft

Good gentile exfoliating cleanser. Went to a facial and they recommended Dermalogica one. This one seems similar at a much more reasonable price. Since it's powder, I'm definitely bringing this on trips too.

Beware if you have sensitive skin! Seriously burned my face and neck. Washed my face and neck with this stuff and got a rash on my face and neck that burned really bad. After 2 days of being inflamed and burning, my skin turned rough and leathery feeling wherever the rash was and still burns. I normally don't leave negative reviews but I also never had my skin react like this to a product before. Didn't want anyone else to experience this problem. Really has been quite painful so I recommend you use with caution if used at all.

The ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is a very unique type of cleansing face wash. Once you get the powder wet it then dissolves and becomes a more foamy type of cleanser. It leaves skin feeling instantly softer, due to the exfoliating properties it has, and makes skin instantly brighter and more glowing! It quickly and easily removes any and all makeup, dirt, etc from the skin while cleansing. It even removes waterproof mascara easily! I do want to note, that although this face cleanser does not irritate my skin (which is prone to being sensitive with certain products) , if I don't use some kind of moisturizer afterwards my skin does end up being pretty dry the following day! So DONT forget to use your moisturizers afterwards!
My skin looked noticeably brighter after the first use. My skin looks smooth and feels soft. A little goes a long way—it turns into a nice creamy foam when water is added. Highly recommend!
My skin is super glowy and my is softer than it has ever been. Highly recommend this product!

The Cleansing Powder was something completely new for me. It cleaned my face well without making it feel dry or tight. My skin felt smooth and soft afterward. Plus, since it's a powder, it's great for traveling—no worrying about spills or liquid restrictions. "This review was collected as part of a promotion"

avis.titre: ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder
avis.texte: My name is Gabby and I'm a licensed Cosmetologist. I received the Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder. This powder to cleanser is super easy to use. Once mixed with water it reminds me of bean essence. I let it sit on my face for five minutes like a face mask. It gives your skin a slip and shine. I love the instant brightness and that it has a nice lather especially for my combination skin type. I like the compact packaging and that Anua products are reasonably priced. This cleanser pairs nicely with the Anua cleansing oil. Plus it's great to see the benefits of using rice on my skin as opposed to hair products. Using this is beneficial for evening out your skin tone. Overall, I would recommend this rice cleanser and give it five out of five stars.

avis.titre: New to this formula, but I like it
avis.texte: I'm partial to cleansing oil/ cream cleanser, so this took me for a surprise. However, I was pleasantly surprised. A little goes a LONG way as far as lather goes. The lather is rich but not slimy feeling and left my face really feeling clean. The scent wasn't overpowering either.

This rice brightening cleanser has been a great addition to my skincare routine. I've only seen a few products similar to this and I was excited to try it. The powder formula was very unique as it served as a cleanser and exfoliator in one. It has many great benefits for the skin. My skin felt a lot more smoother because of the exfoliating rice enzymes. It felt squeaky clean especially after a long day of wearing makeup. What I loved most is that it didn't dry out my skin. My skin actually felt more hydrated and soft after use. It's gentle enough for daily use or on days when your skin is feeling dull. I dispensed about a half teaspoon into my hands and it was the perfect amount to get a good lather and thoroughly cleanse my skin. And can I just say it gives me the perfect smooth skin for makeup application? No more dry patches of skin. This is definitely something I will be keeping in my routine.

The product packaging was interesting. It had a seal for the powder to prevent spilling, which is always nice. When turned upside down, the product dispenses into a small tunnel, which you twist to get the product out, instead of pouring a ton of it out into your hands. On my first application, I followed the directions and added a small amount fo water to the powder in my hands and massaged it on my face. I quickly realized that I used way too much of it, and that a little goes a really long way. The most surprising part was the texture of the product, which was slimey. It didn't feel "exfoliating" but it felt like I was washing my face with a smooth pulverized rice, bran type of texture. The product didn't foam but it did feel like a mask sort of, like I was supposed to apply it then leave it on. It's not something I would reach for often, but I would use it if my skin felt dry and like it needed a bit of gentle exfoliation.

I was super excited to hear that Anua was releasing a new cleanser, because I love their products and I was actually on the hunt for a new cleanser since mine was running low. A couple things I look for when finding the perfect cleanser is one that has gentle exfoliation, and is safe for my sensitive and acne prone skin. This cleanser had both, and managed to brighten my dull skin.

The finely milled texture transforms into a luxurious, creamy lather when mixed with water, making it perfect for a deep yet non-stripping cleanse. My skin feels incredibly soft and smooth afterward, and over time, I've seen a visible improvement in brightness and texture. The rice enzymes work wonders in gently exfoliating dead skin cells without irritation, even for my sensitive skin. It's also perfect for maintaining a healthy glow and works well as part of my double-cleansing routine.

This product is one of the two products I've tried by Anua recently. I've also tried hydrating rice ceramide serum. I have dry to normal skin type with a hormone imbalance for some background information. This serum has a texture that's similar to most other rice cleansing powders I've tried. The main textural difference is though this melts into a nice cleansing foam, it's coarser feeling before adding water. It does not remain to feel as abrasive though. I find that this cleansing exfoliant isn't as hydrating as I hoped it would be. It doesn't take much to use though for it to foam and it feels nice when using it, but the hydrating feeling it just doesn't last for me sadly. I've also noticed my skin feels more tight than usual after using it. I say give it a shot though because everyone's skin biome is different so it may work for you unlike it did for me. You never know until you try.

I've been testing this cleansing powder for the past few weeks and I absolutely love it!! I think the powder is such a unique way of deeply cleansing your skin, while also providing so many other benefits to healthy and glowy skin. I definitely recommend this!

avis.titre: My skin is so much smoother!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love the ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder! This product has transformed my skincare routine. The powder is super gentle yet effective at exfoliating, leaving my skin feeling clean, soft, and smooth without any irritation. It lathers beautifully with just a little water and rinses off easily. Over time, I've noticed my complexion looking brighter and more even-toned, thanks to the rice enzyme. It's also great for sensitive skin and doesn't leave my face feeling dry or tight. The packaging is compact and travel-friendly, making it easy to use on the go. Highly recommend for anyone looking to achieve a radiant glow!

T he Anua Rice Cleansing Powder has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine, offering the same gentle exfoliation and brightening benefits I loved from Dermalogica's Rice Enzyme Powder, but at a much more affordable price. Whether you have sensitive skin, are looking for a gentle exfoliant, or simply want a product that delivers smooth, radiant skin without breaking the bank, this product is definitely worth trying. Its simplicity, effectiveness, and budget-friendly price point make it a standout in the crowded world of exfoliating powders. I highly recommend giving it a try — your skin will thank you!

I've been using the Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder for the last couple of days now, and I'm absolutely in love with it. It removes dirt, and oil effortlessly, making my face look brighter and more hydrated after every use without stripping my skin barrier. I have noticed my skin looks brighter and my skin texture feels noticeably smoother. It's also really easy to use! You can just sprinkle some of the powder on your hand, and add a little bit of water to create a creamy lather. I am able to control the consistency and amount of the powder, and I love that it is scentless - which is perfect if you are really sensitive to smells. I also really love the packaging; it is compact making it travel-friendly. Overall I would definitely recommend this cleanser!

The Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is a standout addition to any skincare routine. This gentle exfoliating powder transforms into a creamy lather with water, effectively removing impurities and dead skin without irritation. Infused with rice enzymes, it brightens and evens skin tone, leaving my complexion looking radiant and refreshed. I appreciate its lightweight formula and the fact that it's suitable for all skin types. The subtle, pleasant scent adds to the experience. After consistent use, I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and brightness. It also helps to minimize the appearance of pores, making my skin feel smoother. Highly recommended for a glowing, clean finish! This product has truly elevated my skincare regimen, and I can't imagine being without it.

I am a professional makeup artist and skincare enthusiast, I have tried many skincare lines and Korean skincare is on of my favorite , I was excited to try this brand and hasn't disappoint me . I have tried many powder exfoliating but this one is one of the best I have ever tried , this is A must have in my routine! Anua rice powder is a great exfoliator for daily use, will not dry out my skin at all! I do not get any irritation on my face afterwards and no texture issues since using it! I have noticed that my pores are not getting clogged specifically on my T -zone and my other skincare products and makeup applies/ lays better.

Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder✨ -My skin felt incredibly smooth after using this magical powder. It's gentle on application and my skin's clarity improved noticeably. Hydration and brightness? Check and check! Five stars—highly recommend trying it out!

It's out with the old and in with the new with this one. This compact product is glowness on the go! I love how the packaging is perfect for travel. I tend to overindulge when it comes to cleansing but a little bit of powder goes a long way. It emulsifies on impact and the product reminds me of dermalogica's microfoliant except the particles are sized bigger and the texture can feel a little bit more grainy on impact like a scrub. Making it the perfect dupe for a $60 product. Even though it is the same price as Dermalogica's Microfoliant mini, you are still getting more powder with Anua. From the first use, my skin immideately looked less dull. I have been dealing with texture, acne flares, and added dryness thanks to the season, but using this cleanser allowed the rest of my products absorb easier. When pairing powder with the hydrating barrier serum I noticed an acne scar I had has been slowing fading. By adding an oil cleanser, radiance masks like Tata Harper or detox masks like Malin + Goetz, moisturizer i.e. La Roche Posay, and a sunscreen when needed; my skin has evened out significantly. I usually would add an undereye retinol alternative treatment to lighten the dark circles but I don't necessarily need it with this regimen. I would recommend not using this product every day to avoid overexfoilating and overcleansing because it can disrupt your moisture barrier. I tested using this product everyday for a week and by day four, I noticed light irritation bumps. So this
This brightening powder is beautiful! I use this with wet hands on a wet, clean face and it foams up so nicely and leaves my face feeling so soft and smooth. So great for the price!

Cleansing powders are a new thing for me. I've only tried one or two, but I must say that the Anua cleansing powder is my favorite so far. What sets it apart from others is the texture and feel on the skin. If I'm using it at night I will double cleanse to make sure my makeup is fully removed from my face. Using the powder as a second cleanser is what works best for me. Using it as a mask is a brilliant way to use this product as well. When My face looks dull and needs a little extra TLC I will use the cleanser as a mask and it makes my face look and feel so refreshed. The powder is effective yet gentle on my skin. The most remarkable thing about the cleanser is the slip. It makes my skin feel so soft. After rinsing my skin definitely looks brighter and healthier. This is staying in my skincare routine for the forseeable future.

I have been using the RICE ENZYME BRIGHTENING CLEANSING POWDER for the past few days , and I can confidently say that it has transformed my skincare routine for the better. Here are several reasons why I absolutely love this product: One of the aspects that impressed me the most about this cleansing powder is its gentle formulation. Unlike some harsh cleansers that strip the skin of its natural oils, this product effectively removes dirt, makeup, and impurities without causing irritation. The fine rice powder gently exfoliates the skin, leaving it feeling fresh The brightening effect is undeniable. The rice enzymes work to promote a more radiant complexion by improving skin texture and tone. I've noticed that my skin appears brighter and more even since I started using this product. It's particularly helpful for targeting dullness and uneven skin tone. I appreciate the flexibility of this cleansing powder. Depending on my skin's needs, I can adjust the amount of water I use to create a paste that's thicker or thinner. On days when my skin feels particularly oily or congested, I can use less water and leave the mixture on for a minute or two as a quick mask. It allows me to personalize my cleansing experience!

I'm absolutely loving the ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder! As a beauty enthusiast, I'm always on the lookout for products that deliver on their promises, and this one certainly does. This gentle, non-foaming powder cleanser effectively removes dirt and impurities while brightening and evening out my skin tone. I've noticed a significant reduction in hyperpigmentation and a more radiant complexion overall. The rice enzyme and licorice extract ingredients work synergistically to provide a deep cleanse without stripping my skin of its natural oils. I was impressed to find that ANUA's formula is free from harsh chemicals, artificial fragrances, and dyes, making it perfect for sensitive skin types. The packaging is also eco-friendly and travel-friendly, which is a big plus in my book!

The Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder has quickly become a standout in my skincare routine. This product is a gentle yet effective cleanser that works wonders for brightening and exfoliating the skin. The powder format is unique, and once mixed with water, it transforms into a soft, creamy lather that feels incredibly soothing on the skin. What I love most about this cleansing powder is how mild it is on my skin. Despite its exfoliating properties, it doesn't feel harsh or abrasive, making it perfect for my sensitive skin. The rice enzymes provide gentle exfoliation, sloughing off dead skin cells and leaving my complexion looking brighter and smoother. I have noticed that my skin tone has become more even, and any dullness has been visibly reduced after regular use. It also does a great job of removing dirt, oil, and makeup without leaving my skin feeling stripped or dry. Instead, my face feels clean, refreshed, and comfortably hydrated. The Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is an excellent addition to any skincare routine, especially for those looking for a gentle exfoliant that brightens the skin. It delivers impressive results without causing irritation, making it suitable for even sensitive skin types.

I enjoyed trying this Anua rice enzyme brightening cleansing powder. I have only ever used liquid before so this seemed intriguing from the start. Just note you have to remove the tab inside or the powder will not pour out. Then I would just mix in a few drops of water and it foams/suds up really well. I was also worried that it might feel too abrasive on my face since it is a powder but it was not true. It felt soft on the skin once it got foamy and it made my skin feel clean. I will also note that it did not remove my mascara though but if you double cleanse with an oil based cleanser first that will not be a problem. It did not really have any scent which I liked. All in all I had a good experience and would recommend this to anyone wanting to try a new cleanser.

I've never heard of a cleansing powder before. Not even on social media. Especially not one made by Anua. This EATS down. I prefer the texture of the cleanser after adding water to the regular ones. It is very brightening. So it does live up to its purpose. It cleans super well. Purchase her!!!

I enjoyed this face mask it can be used as a super mild exfoliant or a thicker face mask consistency. I like that it leaves my skin glowing and hydrated! It does not cause any tears to my skin or irritation. My skin strips easily but this keep it supple and plump. If you use this 3x a week your skin will be glowy like glass skin. It looks like a little bottle but you don't need alot. I recommend you to use in a bowl and purchase a fan brush for application of the formula, once you mix it up then you can apply it so easily with the brush. I apply mine on my face down to my neck and upper chest area. When I am lazy or in a hurry and don't have much time then I just put a pea size into my palm and add a little bit of water before applying the formula onto my face with my hands I then work it down to my neck. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

This is one of the most unexpectedly, well-performing (yet FUN) K-Beauty products I've encountered. While this Rice Enzyme is 'noted' as being a cleanser, it can also be utilized as a face-mask, which I have yet to try. However, this is fairly easy to use. Flip the top, tap the 'rice powder' out into your hand, lather it well with water and just like that -- it's a face wash! The powder granules are very grainy, but somehow also fluffy to the touch. When lathered well, the granules almost become 'subtly exfoliating beads'. They aren't harsh on your skin and are fragrance-free. I will say, even after the first few uses, I have noticed nicer texture to my skin as well as more brightness, especially right after washing it off! ANUA, this one ACTUALLY is a hit!

As a busy mom and athlete, I don't always have the luxury of devoting much time to skincare. However, as I rapidly approach middle age, I now appreciate the importance of high-quality products that are both easy to use and effective. My skin, which endures a lot during my daily runs and accumulates dirt and oil throughout the day, needs a cleanser that can perform without compromising on gentleness. This cleansing powder has become my favorite for those reasons. It's gentle and hydrating. Unlike other cleansers that leave my skin feeling tight and dry, this one actually leaves my skin feeling softer after each use—something I've never experienced with a cleanser before. At the same time, it thoroughly cleanses, so I don't feel any weird residue afterwards. The formula includes a rice extract, arbutin, and papain- which addresses uneven skin tone and dullness. It also contains mild AHAs that gently exfoliate. My complexion is so much brighter after I use it. For anyone who wants a cleanser that is efficient, gentle, and capable of enhancing skin tone and texture, I cannot recommend this product enough. Its quick and easy to use and beyond gentle.

This product truly delivers on its hydrating and moisturizing claims, with a rich, thick texture reminiscent of aloe vera. When applied to the face, it feels rejuvenating and intensely moisturizing, and while it can be a bit slimy to remove, the end result is well worth the end feeling. This review was collected as part of a promotion

This was my first time trying out Anua skincare, and I can see now why many different skin types like their products! This cleansing powder is very softening on skin, but immediately brightens and cleansing effectively. I love how because its a powder, its no-mess for travel. I also really enjoy using it as a mask, to help brighten my face or gently exfoliate it.

I was a bit wary of this powder cleanser as some can be too rough/exfoliating for my skin. However this cleanser has delivered in all aspects! I use this as my second cleanser/Water based cleanser. I also love that this product can be used as a wash off face mask so it's actually dual purpose! The packaging is lovely, and allows me to dispense an appropriate amount of product without any buildup or risk of water getting inside and ruining the cleanser. The powder is fragrance free and lathers perfectly when water is added so that I don't have to use much product to wash my face :) there are no harsh pebbles or grains scraping my face! I've been using this cleanser everyday and the amount of exfoliation is perfect, definitely very gentle. I now have brighter/ more even skin that is never irritated or stripped dry. Instead it's soothed and refreshed thanks to rice powder, kaolin, ceramides, and more.

I love the feel if this cleanser. My biggest fear when starting it was that it would be too gritty and feel painful on my skin, yet this wasn't mu experience at all. When combined with a last of water it takes on the texture of a milky cleanser and is gentle on the skin. When combined with less water it becomes more mask like, but still isn't harsh or gritty. The only part I found difficult was how much water to add, but as I used it more I got the hang of it. There is no distinct scent to it, so those with sensitive skin can use it to. I honestly even prefer this to my gel cleanser. If there wasn't the risk of over exfoliating I would use it both day and night. I will say that you truly only need a little of the powder, as it foams up a lot.

This cleanser can be set apart from other cleaners as it is very different than the standard type of liquid cleansers. The powder allows for smaller packaging, taking less room on your vanity or shelves, easier to travel with and yet still offers the same quality of cleansing and lasts just as long. It's very easy to use and actually a little fun. I love the ingredients and how simple it is. I would definitely recommend picking up this cleanser.

Anuas Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder was an amazing introduction into the world of Cleansing powders for me. It was a bit weird at first as I am a texture person but I can say it has an amazing Cleansing effect. Once it was emulsified it was amazing removing all the excess grime and makeup from the face without stripping the skin of its natural oils. It left my skin feeling hydrated but clean. Also a little goes a long way!! A dimension size amount of the powder gets the job done. Also with it being a Powder the slight grit to it gives it an exfoliating property that again your skin will thank you for. It's not to abrasive as once combined with the water it breaks it down. Overall I would recommend this product if you're a beginner in your Skincare journey or an OG!

I will start off by saying that since this product is a powder, it is difficult at first to gauge the right amount of product to use. There definitely was a learning curve for me to figure out the sufficient amount of powder to use so I didn't waste any product. The powder lathers up well and is easy to apply to the face. I will say it absolutely worked wonders for exfoliating my skin. It got a lot of dead skin off and left my face feeling very smooth. I will say this powder does have a rather unpleasant smell to it, it somewhat reminds me of yeast. However, the smell wasn't so severe that it detracted from my experience with the product. The main downside of this product is that it left a film on my skin after using it. I felt like I needed to wash my face again to get the remnants of this product off.

Loving this product so far! It's gentle and nourishing, and does a great job at gently exfoliating dead skin cells. Rice products are known for skin brightening, but the added alpha-arbutin really helps with dark spots. The ceramides are soothing and nourish your skin, while protecting the barrier. I've been using it mostly as a wash off mask, but I found that the recommended amount of 1 tbs is a little too much, and not really necessary. I use about 1/2 tbs and I'm able to get a nice billowy foam. However, when I used only 1/2 tbs, I don't get that marshmallow fluff consistency that has been really popular. After using, my skin feels soft, clean, and hydrated. Would recommend!

avis.titre: A Skincare Must-Have for Radiance and Balance
avis.texte: This product has completely transformed my skin. It's improved clarity, balanced my complexion, and left my face feeling deeply soothed and hydrated. The standout ingredients- rice extract water, arbutin, and ceramides- work together to brighten, protect, and nourish the skin. My face feels softer, looks more radiant, and stays hydrated all day. It's a gentle yet effective solution for anyone looking to achieve a glowing, well balanced complexion. I can't imagine my routine without now!

avis.titre: Match made in Heaven for me!!!
avis.texte: The ANUA Rice + Ceramide Cleansing Powder is a game-changer in my skincare routine. Its finely milled powder transforms into a soft, creamy lather, providing gentle exfoliation without stripping my skin. Infused with rice extract and ceramides, it leaves my face feeling clean, smooth, and hydrated. Perfect for sensitive skin, it doesn't irritate or dry out, making it ideal for daily use. The Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum complements the cleanser beautifully. Its lightweight, silky texture absorbs quickly, delivering intense hydration while strengthening the skin barrier. Enriched with rice extract and ceramides, it soothes redness and improves elasticity, leaving my skin plump and radiant. Together, these products work synergistically to achieve a balanced, nourished complexion. Highly recommended for those seeking gentle yet effective skincare solutions.

I have been using this rice powder for a week and i kid you not it is one of the best skin brightening rice powders. It has enzymes and ceramides that helps rejuvenate your skin. Arbutrin helps moosturizing the skin making it look radiant and glowing. I have been using it morning and evening and a cleanser and used is a face mask couple of times. Best skins care routine i have tried in some Time. I have stopped using any other skin care products ever since I have been using Anua's products to get the best out of it. The rice powder is not like a fine powder , its tiny granules but melts instantly when mixed with water and turns into foam while rubbing on your palm. The powder gently exofliates the skin leaving the skin fresh, smootha nd hydrated. It is improving my skin texture and fading the post pimple/acne scar away. Definitely recommended if you have sensitive option

Let me just start with this cleanser paste is the bomb. I recently got bored of the cleansers I've currently been using- this one takes the cake. Once you mix the powder with water it makes a wonderful cleansing paste. It lathers so well. I even feel a slight exfoliation which is great. Great benefits with rice and ceramic. I also appreciate that it's hydrating my skin doesn't feel dry after washing this powder. The best part is that this product doubles as a mask! I tried it for 20 minutes and it was super refreshing. This is my first time trying anua and I will be buying this product again. I saw great results in my skin within a weeks time. My skin appeared clearer, toned , and refreshed. I like that there is no real fragrance or harsh chemicals in the product just simple ingredients and potent skin care.

When I first came across the ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder, I was intrigued. It promised to be a gentle exfoliant that could also brighten my complexion, all while being super easy to use. I'm always on the lookout for something that will cleanse without stripping my skin, especially because I have somewhat sensitive skin that tends to get dry if I use harsh products. After using it my skin felt fresh and clean. I am looking forward to using it more and see its impact over time.

I have acne prone skin and have tried several cleansing powders from different brands, but they've always been too harsh for me. However, the cleansing powder from Anua is completely different. I love using this as a second cleanser, it leaves my skin soft, glowing, and hydrated, with no dryness or stripped feeling! That said, it also works great as a first cleanser! Great packaging, very convenient for travel. I love how easy it is to use, just add water! Personally, I like to mix it with my toner! I also love using it as a mask, and the results are even more impressive. This product has been an amazing addition to my skincare routine! I'm already thrilled with the results after just a few days and can't wait to see how radiant my skin will be with continued use. I definitely recommend this to anyone looking for a convenient cleanser that delivers its promises ! This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: A cleanser and so much more
avis.texte: This cleanser goes above and beyond typical face washing. It thoroughly cleanses skin and also provides gentle exfoliation. I love the unique texture that starts as a powder and transforms into a dense foam with water. It's skin loving blend of ingredients includes rice bran grains, ceramide and papain. This cleanser leaves skin free of dirt, makeup and impurities. The benefits don't stop there as it also hydrates, balances, soothes and improves skin clarity. After just one use of this cleanser, I knew it was perfect for my skin. Its so pampering and nourishing. I love how it makes my skin look and feel just beautiful. Bright, healthy, refreshed skin is no longer just a dream with this cleanser. It's definitely one I recommend for any skincare routine.

avis.titre: Wanted to love but not for me
avis.texte: As a beauty enthusiast, I've been a big fan on Korean skincare for years now. But never having tried a powder cleanser before I was so excited to try the Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder by ANUA. Formulated with rice water and packed with ceramides, this multipurpose cleanser promises to make your skin more balanced and bright. One of the things that stood out most to me is you can use it one of two ways; add the powder with water to create a cleansing foam or create a paste with water to use as a mask. My initial impression was positive; I love that a little bit of product goes a long way. Although there is a little trial and error at first because using too much of the powder can make it a little more difficult to rinse off. I was definitely glad I was in the shower the first time I used it. Once I rinsed it off my skin felt deeply cleansed but so incredibly moisturized. I wasn't expecting that with clay being a main ingredient of the powder! However, there must be an ingredient that doesn't agree with me because within 20 minutes my skin had big red blotches. I tried it several more times after just in case it was user error and maybe I didn't rinse well enough because other than the blotches my skin felt SO GOOD after using it but unfortunately had the same experience each time. Everyone's skin is different so I would still recommend the cleanser to anyone looking for brighter more radiant skin. *this review was collected as part of a promotion

I have been using this cleansing powder the last few days and really enjoying it. This powder has pretty fine granules and a little goes a very long way. The granules transform into a foaming cleanser quickly and feel very smooth on the skin. The foam has a very silky, soft lather. My skin gets gently exfoliated and feels very clean after using this powder cleanser. If I use this more than 2-3x a week I do experience some dryness but right now I'm just seeing how my skin is adjusting to using it. I love the packaging, I think it is very sleek and elegant. The cap did confuse me and first but I understand the reason of the shape. The cap makes it easy to pour a small amount of product into my hand and if I do take to much I can easily pour it back in.

As a beauty influencer, brand ambassador, beauty content creator, makeup and beauty product seller, and as a person who has knowledge and experience in cosmetics, beauty products, and makeup; I recommend Anua Cleansing Powder. This product offers a very clean, healthy, and unique experience. The powder of this beauty cleanser is very effective, and it blends well with water. Washing my face with it was very calming, relaxing, and sufficient. The powder has no scent, and the container is very practical to use. I apply a small amount of this powder on my wet face. The powder slowly turns into a creamy lather that deeply cleans my skin. I love how this powder exfoliate my skin gently. Thus, my skin looks cleaner, brighter, and softer after usage.

This brightening cleansing powder is so innovate and cool because of the way you have to mix with water. I feel like this cleaners helped clear out most of my pores. It also left it feeling very cleaning! I love this and would recommend it to friends!

I have really gotten interested in Korean skin care products over the past few years not just because of the social media hype, but because of the minimalist and direct approach without all the extra fluff including the higher end price tag. I have been enjoying this cleaning powder for about a week now and these are my thoughts; I find the texture and ease of application fun and I do find the formula to be innovative and trendy. This has Kaolin in it that is found in clay masks which is interesting. Its simple to wash off and while I found my skin to feel refreshed and not stripped, I have not noticed any brightening. I would say that this product is an effective exfoliate that I'd recommend using three times per week and not to use other products with actives during those days. Overall, fun to use and I do enjoy it.

I have been looking for a new cleanser and saw so many people raving about this product on tiktok that i figured I'd give it a try!! I'm so glad I came across this because it's truly the best cleanser! My face feels so clean but so soft after using!

To describe this amazing cleanser I would have to compare it to fresh mochi because of its sticky texture and color. It starts in powder form and with a small amount of water it turns into a paste similar to a sourdough starter. It cleans up pores like it's no one's business, removing excess oil and stripping dead skin cells leaving nothing behind but smooth and healthy skin. The packaging is easy to use with an opening dispensing a good amount of product. I highly recommend this to anyone with a love for interesting skincare products looking to add a unique cleaner to their collection or in need of an easy to travel with cleanser. I do not recommend this for people with texture issues.

Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is my new favorite daily cleaner. My experience has been great and I am impressed with the product. The packaging is nice and the product itself is so lightweight which makes it perfect for traveling. It's unscented and lathers extremely well, you don't need to use a lot at all! I love how it can be used as a mask if you want a deeper clean. You can feel the grains but they're not painful and don't stick to your face. My skin looks and feels cleaner after using the product every morning. I can see a slight difference in my complexion it has gotten brighter so far. I haven't had any breakouts or bad reactions from the powder. It's great for people with sensitive skin and dry skin like me. This is the best cleaning powder I've ever tried and it's something I would repurchase.

RICE ENZYME BRIGHTENING CLEANSING POWDER every wash! Gentle enough for daily use but powerful enough to leave your skin baby-soft and visibly brighter. The enzyme-based formula lathers beautifully, turning your cleansing step into a spa-like experience. Say goodbye to dullness and hello to that lit-from-within glow.

This has quickly earned a spot as one of my favorite skincare products ever. This cleansing powder mixes with water into a wonderful creaming consistency that truly brightens the complexion with one use. I love how much brighter, lighter, and tighter my skin looked and felt after using this product, and I highly recommend to others who are fighting dullness with their complexion.

The ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is a truly remarkable product that caught me off guard in the best way. As an advanced esthetician, I've tried countless cleansers, but this one stands out for its innovative form and exceptional performance. The finely milled powder activates with a small amount of water, transforming into a silky, luxurious lather that feels gentle yet effective on the skin. Not only does it cleanse thoroughly, but it also brightens and refreshes the complexion, leaving the skin smooth, soft, and glowing. I love using it in the morning as part of my pre-makeup routine because it creates the perfect canvas for flawless application. It's rare to find a product that combines unique texture, ease of use, and visible results, but ANUA has managed to do just that. This cleanser is now a staple in my skincare arsenal, and I can't recommend it enough!

This cleansing powder is so so good. I love the unique texture and how it cleans and exfoliates without over drying. It is perfect for my sensitive skin and it improved my texture and brightness in 7 days of use.

This cleansing powder surprised me with how gentle yet effective it is. The powder transforms into a soft, foamy cleanser that feels so light and refreshing on the skin. After just a few uses, I noticed my complexion looking more even and noticeably brighter. It's a joy to use because it doesn't strip my skin or leave it feeling tight—just clean, smooth, and comfortable. The rice enzymes provide a gentle exfoliation that works without any harshness, making it ideal for my dry, sensitive skin. I've made it a daily part of my routine, and my skin stays soft, hydrated, and refreshed. Its compact and travel-friendly packaging adds to the convenience, making it a staple in my skincare kit. If you're looking for a cleanser that doubles as a mild exfoliant while keeping your skin healthy and balanced, this is definitely worth exploring. This review was collected as part of a promotion

I've been using the Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder for a while, and it's one of the best cleansers I've tried. The powder formula is unique and fun—just add a little water, and it transforms into a soft foam. It's mess-free and easy to control how much you need. It exfoliates gently without being harsh, leaving my skin smooth and refreshed. My face never feels tight or dry afterward, which is a big plus. After just one use, my skin felt softer and looked brighter. Over time, my complexion has become more even and balanced, living up to the promises of improved clarity and hydration. I love that it's formulated with rice extract water, Arbutin, and Ceramide. These ingredients work really well for soothing and hydrating my skin, and it's fragrance-free, which is great for sensitive skin. This cleanser doubles as a gentle exfoliant, so it simplifies my skincare routine. It's perfect if you want something effective that leaves your skin clean, bright, and hydrated. Highly recommend!

Korean skincare has been making its way around and I just had to try it out for myself. Anua is not a new brand to my skincare collection. I absolutely adore their cleaning oil and niacinamide serum. I've had amazing results with those products in particular. The rice enzyme brightening cleansing powder however, was a bit disappointing. I do think the aspect of having to mix the powder and water is a cool concept but it can get messy and too much powder can be poured out. When I'm in a rush I just want a one and done type of product. I did notice how soft my skin was when using the cleansing powder and it claims to be hydrating and non drying but that wasn't my experience. I have dry acne prone skin and my skin felt tight. It is fragrance free which I could appreciate but I would pass this cleansing powder up and stick to my orginal cleansing liquid.

This is such a great multi-purpose cleanser. You get a little scrub action and then the milky goodness from the lactic acid. You don't need much and the spout could be a bit smaller. It is a bit tough to get rinsed off so I prefer it in the shower but my skin is soft and hydrated. This unscented formulation is great k-beauty find and my skin is very happy.

The ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is a gentle, rice-based exfoliating cleanser that effectively brightens and smooths the skin without irritation. Its ultra-fine powder activates with water to create a creamy lather, offering mild exfoliation that's suitable for daily use and all skin types, including sensitive skin. Infused with rice bran extract and papain enzymes, it helps remove dirt, oil, and light makeup while reducing dullness and uneven skin tone over time. While it's not ideal for removing heavy or waterproof makeup and may feel slightly drying for very dry skin if overused, it leaves the skin refreshed, smooth, and noticeably radiant. This travel-friendly cleanser is perfect for those looking to achieve a natural glow with a non-abrasive product, making it a valuable addition to any skincare routine.

The Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder reminds me of the Amore Pacific Treatment Enzyme Peel Cleansing Powder at a fraction of the price. You tap the powder out from the bottle, then add water to activate and emulsify it, gently wash your face in circular motions to break up the grime and dead skin. My skin feels clean and smooth afterwards, never taught or dry. A bonus usage is to mix the milky toner from the same line to make your own wash off mask, you mix with 1:1 ratio, leave the paste on for 15 mins then wash off, there's an immediate brightness to my skin ton afterwards, highly recommend! "This review was collected as part of a promotion"

The Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder reminds me of the Amore Pacific Treatment Enzyme Peel Cleansing Powder at a fraction of the price. You tap the powder out from the bottle, then add water to activate and emulsify it, gently wash your face in circular motions to break up the grime and dead skin. My skin feels clean and smooth afterwards, never taught or dry. A bonus usage is to mix the milky toner from the same line to make your own wash off mask, you mix with 1:1 ratio, leave the paste on for 15 mins then wash off, there's an immediate brightness to my skin ton afterwards, highly recommend! "This review was collected as part of a promotion"

This product was my introduction to this brand and it has been a pleasant experience thus far! I was immediately drawn to the blend of brightening ingredients since I struggle with a bit of hyperpigmentation. When activated with water and applied to the skin, this enzyme powder feels extremely gentle and lathers quite well. There's no scent at all and I didn't experience any irritation. Although I haven't tried it yet, I love that this product has a dual purpose and can be used in conjunction with the Anua toner to create a treatment mask. I'm definitely looking forward to consistently using this product in my skincare routine and hopefully experiencing more even and smooth skin.

As a lover of Korean Skincare brands I was excited to be able to see what the ANUA Rice line had to offer. I keep my skincare routine fairly simple: double cleanse, serum, moisturizer, eye cream & spf. Using the Rice Cleasning Powder in place of my second cleanse was a pleasant experience. I enjoyed the powder aspect of the product. It took me a few tries to get the perfect water to powder ratio that best worked for me but once I did it was fine. As far as the cleansing I did feel like it provided a deep and thorough cleanse without leaving my skin feeling overly tight or dry. The pores on my nose looked noticeably smaller and my skin overall felt smoother with continued use. I also noticed you can use a toner in place of the water to make more of a leave on mask treatment which I am excited to try next. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.
Great cleansing!! Applys very easy on the face!! It's a powder that turns into a formy layer on the face!! Great product to use!!!

avis.titre: My new go to face cleanser
avis.texte: The Anua enzyme brightening powder works great. Hells clean out pores and helps breakouts. Helps with uneven skin tone and helps brighten and moisturize your face. It's a powder form you just use a small amount in hand add water. ANd it suds up good. I like to leave mine on a bit like a mask then you wash off. I have been using over a week and I have already seen a different in my uneven skin tone and dark spots my face looks brighter and smooth. I can't wait to see the results after I finish bottle. And it won't break the bank.

Wow! This is a beautifully created product with a great formula and quality ingredients! You can use it as a mask just by adding Rice 70+ Toner, making it into a thicker paste! Or you can just use it to wash your face! My face feels so refreshed after using this product! I can't get enough of it!
Great product!! Easy to apply on the face!! It comes in a powder, but applys formy on the face!! Very soft on the skin!!

As a licensed esti I get to try lots of different brands, professional, medical, retail and in between. Korean skincare has always been a very great option - I believe they use great ingredients, they don't add unnecessary filler and other things and their products are generally affordable and effective. I tried the rice enzyme brightening cleansing powder, this cleanser is a powder formula meaning it is poured out into your hands as a dry powder. You add water to emulsify and use this product. The powder is a little gritty and fragrance free. This cleanser has corn starch, rice extract, vitamin c and ceramide. This is a great dual purpose cleanser as you are also able to get a light exfoliation that's gentle enough for daily use. The best way to use this product is to wet your face first and pour a VERY SMALL amount of powder into your wet hands. I notice this product a little bit goes a long way. With powder cleansers you can always add more water but you can't take it away so start with just wet hands and a wet face it should be more than enough. When you rub the powder in your wet hands it will bubble up and emulsify. The more you rub your hands together the less it will exfoliate as the powder grit will dissolve more so if you want more exfoliation you can almost apply it directly to your wet face. I liked this cleanser but have to say I have used a lot of other powder cleansers and this isn't my favorite- I found it a little difficult to fully wash off or feel like it's

This cleansing powder has transformed my dull, uneven complexion. The rice enzymes gently polish away rough patches, leaving my skin feeling incredibly soft after every use. Over time, I've noticed a consistent improvement in brightness, making my face look healthier and more radiant. Initially, I was concerned it might dry out my skin, but it does the opposite—it cleanses deeply while keeping my skin hydrated. The powder format is unique, creating a perfectly creamy texture that feels luxurious. Its compact packaging makes it travel-friendly, and I appreciate its versatility—it doubles as a gentle exfoliating wash-off mask that has worked wonders for me. Plus, it's mild enough for everyday cleansing without disrupting my skin barrier. If you're in search of a gentle yet effective exfoliator to elevate your routine, this one is worth trying. This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: ANUA Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder
avis.texte: As an esthetician, I was so excited to try the RICE ENZYME BRIGHTENING CLEANSING POWDER. I love how you can mix the powder with water to make your own cleanser, it's such a fun addition to my routine! There were definitely some things I loved about this product, but also a couple of things I wasn't thrilled with. First, I wish the hole where the powder comes out was smaller because it was hard to control how much came out. I kept getting too much and felt like I was wasting product. Second, the smell wasn't super enjoyable,it wasn't awful, just not my favorite.That said, the actual cleanse was a solid 10/10. Once you mix the powder with water, it turns into this cool, sticky/foamy, spreadable texture. It's gentle but gives a subtle exfoliation, and the results were amazing. My skin looked brighter right after I used it.

Not my favorite cleanser mainly because it left a strange slimy film on my skin that I would then wash off, but if I didn't wash it off I didn't notice an improvement in my skin's hydration. I usually use the heartleaf pore cleanser and personally prefer that one

I absolutely love the Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder! It gently cleanses my skin, leaving it soft, smooth, and glowing. The mild exfoliation really helps brighten my complexion without causing any irritation, and it's perfect for my sensitive, combination skin. I also adore the light, refreshing scent. My skin feels hydrated and refreshed after every use, and this product has become a staple in my routine.

I've been using the Anua rice+ceramide enzyme brightening cleansing powder for a little while now, and I am already impressed with the results. The packaging is genius; it allows you to control the pour so you don't waste the product, and a little goes a long way. The texture is unique when mixed with water; it transforms into an elastic consistency, which makes it perfect for a gentle facial massage. After the first use, my skin looked visibly brighter and felt moisturized, which is a plus for me. I enjoyed using the cleanser after the gym or on days when my skin needed a boost of moisture and brightness. It doesn't have a strong fragrance, and it's not harsh at all on the skin. This cleanser has quickly become a staple in my daily routine. If you are not into stretchy texture, this may not be for you, but I highly recommend giving this a try for its brightening and hydrating benefits. It's gentle enough for daily use, and I'll continue using it.

I have likes and dislikes with the Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder. I love the rice enzyme base and the fact that it comes in a powder form. I like the brightening effect on my skin and the Ceramide complex. It also contains papain to help lightly exfoliate, my skin needs a light exfoliation every day so I thought this cleanser would be perfect for me. This cleanser is very hydrating and easy to use. I simply shake a little powder into my damp hands and lightly rub my hands together. If I need more water I will add a bit more to a few fingertips. I don't like that this product doesn't get very foamy like it claims. I've tried adding more water and less water and even whipping it with a fan brush. It just doesn't get foamy. It does get slimy. It felt like I was using a slimy cleanser on my skin. My skin did feel nice and clean after rinsing with water, but I don't think this is a cleanser I'd use often. Working in the beauty industry for over 20 years, I would recommend it to someone without texture issues and someone with drier skin. I like that this cleanser really isn't scented and I like the simplicity of the bottle it comes in. I also think it would be great for travel or in the gym/overnight bag.

The Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder is a skincare game-changer. This gentle, powder-to-foam cleanser effectively removes impurities, lightly exfoliates, and leaves skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed without irritation. It's perfect for daily use, especially for sensitive skin, as it doesn't strip away natural oils. After consistent use, I've noticed a brighter, more even complexion and a natural glow that I love. The rice enzymes are soothing yet powerful, and the powder format is incredibly convenient for travel—no leaks or mess. Free from harsh chemicals, it's suitable for all skin types and offers a luxurious, spa-like experience with every wash. If you're looking for a gentle cleanser that brightens and revitalizes your skin, this one delivers. Highly recommend for radiant, healthy skin! This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Brightening Cleanser That Doubles as a Gentle Exfoliator
avis.texte: First Impressions: The packaging is sleek and practical, making it easy to dispense just the right amount of powder. I love how minimalistic it feels—no unnecessary fluff, just a focus on the product. Texture & Application: The powder is finely milled and transforms beautifully into a creamy foam when mixed with water. It's super versatile—you can customize the texture depending on how much water you add. For days when I need a gentle cleanse, I keep it light, and when I need a bit more exfoliation, I mix it into a thicker paste. Performance: After just one use, my skin felt incredibly smooth and looked noticeably brighter. It's gentle enough for my sensitive, mature skin while still effective at removing impurities. I didn't experience any dryness or tightness afterward, which is a huge plus for me. The inclusion of rice powder and ceramides definitely adds to the hydrating and soothing effect. Results Over Time: After using it consistently, I noticed my skin texture improving, and those pesky dull patches looked more even. It's become a key part of my double-cleansing routine as it works perfectly as the second step. Multi-Use Bonus: The fact that it doubles as a wash-off mask is such a win. I've used it with a bit less water, left it on for a few minutes, and my skin felt even more refreshed. Final Thoughts: This is a must-try for anyone looking to gently exfoliate and brighten their complexion. It feels like a mini spa treatment every time I use it, without the hefty pric

This cleanser is very gentle and effective. I love that you don't need a lot of the powder to create an amazing, exfoliating lather. I feel like it does a great job sloughing off dead skin cells but is still gentle on my face. After rinsing, I do feel like there is a barrier left in my face that almost feels a bit silky. I have really been getting into Korean Skincare and I have loved how this has worked for my face. I feel like my face is smoother and has more of a glow to it. I have had no adverse reactions while using this product, only great results. If you truly want to make a big impact on your skin, look no further and definitely start with the Anua Rice Enzyme Brightening Cleansing Powder. I can't wait to try more products from the Anua line.

In general, the product has a beautiful design and is easy to use. Each time you use it, just remove makeup with makeup remover first, then wash your face with water, take a little cleanser into the face washing machine, then turn on the machine, go all over the face to clean, remove dirt, grease and dirt on the face, let the washing machine move and massage so that the cleanser can remove it more effectively, then rinse with water. Persistently use it twice a day, morning and night, and you will see that it makes my skin plump, smooth and feels more elastic. In general, it is effective for me but not really special. Maybe I need to use it for a long time to feel better. I will give it 6/10 points to talk about my satisfaction with the product and will try to persistently use this product to have clear results. I also recommend it to my family and friends because I find it very cheap and effective, so I want to share it with everyone. people who know and try it

I received this product from beauty tap community and I was so excited to try that. It makes my skin very smooth. It is very easy to use and I apply twice a week on my face and I can clearly see the difference. You can easily find it at any ulta store. Highly recommended

avis.titre: Too harsh for my skin - just isn't a match for me
avis.texte: I was very excited to try this product; I had very high hopes. I am a big fan of clean beauty products and want to support them, so trying this product was high on my list. I love the fact that this was based on rice, which has always work great for my hair, but apparently not so great for my skin. This product is meant to be mixed with water to create make a dense foam - easy enough. It slowly became very slimy, and difficult to roll off my skin, which is what the directions call for. Additional instructions stated to rinse off with lukewarm water, which proved challenging, but not a game changer. It eventually rinsed off. Unfortunately, after using the product, my skin felt stripped of any moisture. Sadly, my skin was completely dehydrated. Although this product did not work for my skin, I'm sure several people will love it, as well as the price point.

avis.titre: I would buy this again over similar products
avis.texte: I have never heard of this brand before - this is the first product I have tried and I am pleasantly surprised. You get a ton of product for the cheaper cost compared to similar exfoliating powders on the market. I do have sensitive skin, and I can happily say I've noticed no irritation from this. I like that you can use it as a mask or as a double cleanser. What I've been doing is using my normal gentle cleanser first, then I will cleanse again with this powder. It turns foamy and luxurious once you add the water to it - it feels GREAT! My skin feels a bit brighter and less dry this cold winter season. I would purchase this again for sure! I think it would be great for any skin type.

First, let's talk about the texture. This powder transforms into a silky, creamy foam when mixed with water. It feels luxurious on the skin, almost like a mini spa treatment. The rice enzymes are incredibly fine, so the exfoliation is gentle—perfect for my sensitive skin. Unlike harsher scrubs, this didn't leave me red or irritated. After just one use, my skin felt smoother and looked brighter. Over the course of a week, I noticed my complexion appearing more even, and my dark spots were less noticeable. Plus, it doesn't strip my skin or leave it feeling tight, which is a must for me. Another thing I love is how clean the ingredients feel. The product has no overwhelming fragrance and doesn't rely on harsh chemicals to deliver results. It's effective while still being gentle, making it a great choice for daily use. If I had to nitpick, I'd say it can be a bit messy if you're in a rush (powder products always are), but the results make it worth the minor inconvenience. This produce has earned a permanent spot in my skincare routine, especially for days when my skin needs a little extra TLC.

avis.titre: Shrank my pore size with every use
avis.texte: After using this rice cleansing powder daily for the past week my face feels very smooth and noticeably brighter immediately after using if my skin does feel a little bit taute and slightly dry but I always pair it with the Anua hydrating ceramide barrier serum while my skin is wet after washing and I rub it in until it's dry and it helps keep my skin moisturize, although I still need to apply a thicker moisturizer over it to seal it all in and also keep my skin hydrated. I think for oily skin This is gonna be a game changer because you get the real the benefits of the rice powder and don't have to worry about your skin drying from overuse of this cleanser. I feel like it made my pores look very small, which is very noticeable for my age as they get larger no matter what you do it's also cost effective because you only need a small amount to create lather

avis.titre: Clean skincare to make skin feel amazing
avis.texte: I want to start off by saying this review was collected as part of a promotion. I was so intrigued to try this product as I am a huge skincare junkie. My face's skin tone is uneven due to acne scarring, so I decided to give this a try. I used this to cleanse my face each morning so far so about a week and I have been liking it. It has no scent which is great. It also feels real nice on my skin. I am still currently using the product to see if it helps with acne scarring and evening out my complexion.

avis.titre: I would but the product again.
avis.texte: I did notice a significant improvement in my skin tone after using this product for a week. The only thing I didn't enjoy was the texture of the product. Like many Korean products, it has a slimy texture, which I don't personally find appealing.

avis.titre: Interesting exfoliator, gets the job done!
avis.texte: I really was surprised by this rice exfoliator, usually exfoliators tend to be rough and abrasive on the skin in order to remove all the dead skin cells and debris, this powder definitely isn't abrasive at all, when in contact with a few drops of water I noticed a very sticky and slimey texture which definitely shocked me, I was expecting that type of texture.
